categories.main_business_segments: STAG Industrial, Inc. operates as a single business segment focused on the acquisition, ownership, and operation of industrial properties across the United States. The portfolio primarily consists of warehouse/distribution buildings and light manufacturing facilities, with a small number of flex/office assets and properties under development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: STAG's core operational methods center on real estate acquisition, asset management, and leasing, supported by a proprietary risk assessment model to evaluate property investments. The company employs a fully integrated platform for acquisitions, leasing, and property management, emphasizing efficient, cost-effective operations and capital allocation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: STAG serves a diverse base of tenants across a wide range of industries, including air freight & logistics, containers & packaging, auto components, commercial services, machinery, and e-commerce. Its properties are leased to both single-tenant and multi-tenant users, with no single tenant accounting for more than 3% of annualized base rental revenue and no single industry exceeding 10.9%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in the United States, owning 562 buildings in 41 states as of December 31, 2022. Its largest markets by rental revenue include Chicago, Philadelphia, Greenville/Spartanburg, Milwaukee/Madison, Detroit, Pittsburgh, Columbus, and Minneapolis/St. Paul, with the top 20 markets representing 64.6% of total annualized base rental revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: STAG operates as a downstream participant in the real estate supply chain, providing industrial space for tenants engaged in warehousing, distribution, light manufacturing, and related activities. The company acts as a landlord, offering facilities that support tenants’ logistics, storage, and production needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: STAG’s strategic focus is on disciplined, relative value investing in industrial real estate, portfolio diversification, and sustainable long-term growth in distributable cash flow per share. The company emphasizes risk-adjusted returns, tenant and geographic diversification, and ESG initiatives, including greenhouse gas reduction targets and transparent ESG reporting.
categories.revenue_model: STAG generates revenue primarily through rental income from leasing its industrial properties to tenants under triple net, modified gross, and gross lease structures. Additional revenue streams include tenant reimbursements for property expenses and occasional gains from property sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: STAG competes mainly with local and regional real estate operators, as well as other public and private industrial REITs and real estate funds. Its institutional platform, access to capital, and focus on single-asset acquisitions in secondary and tertiary markets provide a competitive advantage over smaller, less capitalized local investors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, STAG owned assets totaling approximately $6.2 billion, with annual rental income of $654 million and net income of $182 million. The company has demonstrated consistent growth through acquisitions, expanding its portfolio by 26 buildings in 2022, and maintains a strong liquidity position with $847 million in immediate liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: STAG’s value proposition lies in its diversified, risk-managed portfolio of industrial properties, focus on single-tenant assets, and ability to deliver stable cash flows and dividends. Its disciplined acquisition strategy, broad geographic reach, and institutional management platform differentiate it from competitors, while its tenant and industry diversification mitigate risk and enhance resilience.
